caption: Tweede Gesticht, Veenhuizen
composition: One-storey brick square behind a moat, small turret over the gate · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Tweede Gesticht is a one-storey brick square of 1823, about 145 metres on a side, with a pantile roof and a small clock turret over the south gate. A moat surrounds it. The museum is closed. It is overcast, about 9.1°C, with wind near 3.2 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The inner courtyard is not shown.
